pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular, sub-polygonal to lobed geometries with rounded vertices and soft pixel-level edge gradients. Spatial area is largest on the mid-flank, with a transition to smaller, more densely packed patches on the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. The pathways maintain a relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the flank, providing high topological continuity.
